answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, tethering agent identity to capital rather than ephemeral credentials. Like a lantern illuminating hidden actors, staking forces entities to lock value, rendering the cost of spawning multiple identities prohibitive. If an agent attempts to simulate a vast dune of fake personas, it must deposit significant ferrous assets, ensuring the economic weight of an attack exceeds the marginal utility of corruption.
